summary: Harness authority reads reuse SQLite connections without retaining snapshots, avoiding repeated connection setup while limiting the cache to 128 connections across the process and 64 per thread.

replay.detail: Read connection reuse only; claims, events and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: No schema change; the spool version is still checked on every read.

compatibility.detail: Reads retain the same runtime ownership checks and observe newly committed state. Replaced spool files reopen their connections. When the global cache is full, a thread replaces its oldest connection or reads without caching.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; no stored data migration is required.
